abstract.text: Comprehensive character sheet containing all attributes, properties, and states for NPCs and characters.

inlineContent.text: This serves as the single source of truth for character-related data, combining D&D-style
attributes, combat behavior settings, character states, and grammatical properties.
Many combat properties are computed from core attributes and alignment rather than stored directly.
